name: Healdsburg
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Healdsburg?
answer_short: Yes, with the California caps. In Healdsburg, a golf cart may use a street posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district. An LSV may use a road posted 35 mph or less. Streets around the Plaza are posted 20 mph. US 101 is closed to both.

rules.rule: Golf carts on highways posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district
LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections

Healdsburg Avenue is 20 mph from Piper Street to Mill Street, 25 mph through the rest of downtown, 30 mph north to Parkland Farms Boulevard and 35 mph near both city limits. University Avenue, Chiquita Road and South Fitch Mountain Road are 30 mph.
Freeway; no golf carts or LSVs

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Healdsburg?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart around the Healdsburg Plaza?
faq.a: Yes. Healdsburg Avenue, Center Street, Matheson Street and Plaza Street around the Plaza are posted 20 mph, under the 25 mph golf cart cap.

faq.q: Can I take an LSV to the wineries outside Healdsburg?
faq.a: Only on roads posted 35 mph or less. Many county wine roads outside town are faster or unposted, and they show red on the map. An LSV may cross them at an intersection.

faq.q: Does Healdsburg have a golf cart ordinance?
faq.a: No golf cart or NEV transportation plan was found in the city code, so the California state rules apply.
